description:
A desktop audiobook player for Windows, built with Electron.

Midnight Athenaeum plays local audiobook files with real chapter navigation, per-book resume, per-book playback speed, bookmarks, skip-silence, volume normalization, and a sleep timer. A Continue Listening shelf, library filters, and series grouping keep the book you're on one click away, even in a library of thousands. Entirely offline and local -- no account, no server, no telemetry.
Security update: Electron runtime 43.7.5 (more upstream Chromium security fixes) and a hardened audio-tag reader (music-metadata 11.16.1). Also keeps the title, author, narrator and cover of slightly damaged .m4b/.m4a files, which the stricter tag reader would otherwise drop, by reading those details directly from the file.
